intermediate_failures: CLI regression reached app boot before script parsing; moved script loading before boot.
First Arduino run passed 8 S3/C3 examples and rejected 4 C6 examples: descriptor reader used offset 144 instead of 112. Corrected from the installed IDF header and actual ELF section.

redactions.effect: No numeric measurements changed. Commands use explicit caller-supplied input placeholders.

limits: One LE link, MTU 23, no pairing, encryption sessions or RF/baseband model.
Controller time is guest cycles; guest callbacks still poll and yield through FreeRTOS. No physical timing claim.
S3/C3 validated with IDF 5.5.4; other symbol-compatible versions unvalidated. C6 refuses versions outside 5.5.x.
No CPU-time regression was quoted in this review, so no speed experiment was repeated. Disabled-path dispatch and idle code are unchanged; golden outputs are bit-identical.
No JIT implementation changes; wasm-jit-test.sh not required.
